transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I'm just having some issues at work lately. Making some dumb mistakes on my sales reports. Like... copying the wrong numbers down from the team dashboard, or just missing a line in a procedure I was supposed to check. I don't know, even when I thought I went over it, I still miss stuff. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you struggled with this kind of inattention and making careless mistakes since childhood, or is this a more recent problem?

Uh... yeah, I guess I was like this as a kid, too. It's not really new. 

My mom actually still brings it up sometimes. She talks about these old notes she used to get from my teachers in elementary school. Just... saying I rushed through my work, or that I lost my homework. And, uh... I guess they said I talked out of turn a lot. Or couldn't really stay in my seat unless they reminded me. 

So... yeah. Always been kind of like this, I guess.
As an adult, do you currently struggle with feeling restless or having a hard time sitting still?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... meetings are pretty tough. If it's a long one, it just... it feels like I'm kind of buzzing inside, you know? I usually end up shifting around a lot, or tapping my foot. Sometimes I just... make up an excuse to go to the bathroom so I can stand up for a minute. So, yeah. Sitting still isn't my favorite.
